text:
Stop writing long ChatGPT prompts from scratch.

Instead, ask AI to interview you before giving an answer.

How to use it:
• Type: "Ask me 5 questions to get all the context you need for [TASK]."
• Answer the questions in simple bullet points.
• Let it generate the final result with perfect context.

The bottom line:
What used to take 20 minutes of re-writing now takes 2 minutes on the first try.

Have you tried letting AI interview you yet?
